lines.say: Your regular hasn't booked in seven weeks. So you call a SWAT team.
They kick in the fucking wrong door. Then another wrong door. Then a bakery.
Now there's a helicopter, a news crew, and a guy selling hot dogs.
Your client walks up with a coffee going, what the hell is all this? I was just busy.
And you would've gotten away with it, if you'd just texted him at week three.
caps: You'd have gotten away with it

lines.say: MsgHealth flags who's gone quiet, and texts them for you. No SWAT required.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
